name: drift-fuse
description: Scores each unattended turn against the task the person asked for with TypeSafe's Jev model, and after consecutive off-task turns redirects or pauses the next machine-submitted prompt.

driftBelow.title: Drift below
driftBelow.description: On-task probability under which a turn counts as drift

tripAfter.title: Trip after
tripAfter.description: Consecutive drift turns that trip the fuse

onTrip.title: On trip
onTrip.description: redirect: attach a scope warning to the next machine-submitted prompt; pause: drop it

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: unattended: score only turns started by a loop, routine, notification, or SDK prompt; all: score every main-loop turn
